x: Sawyer Memorial Cup: 1st, McMullen, 15 mins. 6.6 secs; 2nd Readman, 15.25; 3rd, East, 15.42. Discus.—Powell Trophy: 1st, Bergvalds, 123 ft. 8½ ins.; 2nd, J. Mackenzie, 110 ft. 7 ins.; 3rd, Higgins, 90 ft. 1 in.
Weight Putt: 1st, Bergvalds, 38 ft. 8½ ins.; 3rd, Powell.

Miska won the Discus handicap from George Powell and the Hop, Step and Jump handicap was won by Ian Forrester. Also on the programme was an 880 yards novices race, open to unattached competitors, but we only had three starters for this and one wonders if there are any unattached athletes about, espe…

Edwards as previously stated won the javelin with Liggins 2nd and Powell 3rd. On the whole it was a most satisfactory Championship day but it would greatly help in the smooth running of the programme if members would enter BEFORE the day so that we get a programme with the correct names on.

Chris Powley battled with English Schools runner-up Powell in the 200m and just finished 2nd. Stuart King, as dependable as ever, got two seconds in the shot and discus, and Phil Clay also took second in the 'B' shot.
